# Bloom Heights

> Bloom Heights is a residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, formed of two towers of 29 and 24 floors that share a ground floor and four-level podium and link internally at podium level. It offers 686 studio to three-bedroom apartments above ground-floor retail. Shared amenities include swimming pools, a gymnasium, a jogging track, a children's play area, a multi-purpose hall and a landscaped deck.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2021

## MENASCO Scope

Bloom Heights is a residential and commercial development by Bloom Properties in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, offering 686 apartments with ground-floor retail. Two towers of 29 and 24 floors rise from a shared ground floor and four-level podium, with amenities including swimming pools, a gym and a jogging track. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the development.
